# Слоўня

> Слоўня — слоўнік жывой мовы. An open Belarusian natural language dictionary with word search, translations from the official standard to the natural language, transliteration (Lacinka), stress marks, blog posts, and community suggestions.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://slounia.vercel.app/): Word search with filters (sort, order, tags), browse the full dictionary
- [Word detail](https://slounia.vercel.app/word/): Individual word pages with translations, stress marks, Lacinka transliteration, related words
- [Blog](https://slounia.vercel.app/blog): Articles about Belarusian language

## API

- [GET /api/words](https://slounia.vercel.app/api/words): Full dictionary data (JSON, ~160 KiB). Supports `search`, `sort`, `order`, `tags`, `offset`, `limit` query params
- [GET /api/likes](https://slounia.vercel.app/api/likes): Like counts for words, translations, and blog posts

## About

- Belarusian language dictionary focused on living, natural usage
- Supports both Cyrillic and Lacinka transliteration
- Community-driven: users can suggest new words and translations
- PWA with offline support for cached assets
